content:
Callouts And Code In MDX

.mdx pages support the same callout and code fence syntax as Markdown pages. They are compiled to sanitized static HTML at build time.

Callouts

Write :::type Title on the first line and ::: on the last line. The five types are note, tip, info, warning, and danger. In MDX, use a plain-text title.

Note

MDX callouts hold Markdown and code.

Breaking change

generate:docs now validates frontmatter.

Outer

Give the outer fence more colons to nest callouts.

Inner

Inner callout.

:::details Title makes a collapsible callout that starts closed.

Show more

Collapsible callouts work in MDX too.

The <Callout> shortcode renders the same callout. type accepts note, tip, info, warning, danger, important, or caution. Put the shortcode on its own lines.

Shortcode form

Never commit deployment credentials.

GitHub Alerts

Tip

GitHub alert syntax also works in MDX.

Code Fence Metadata

setup.sh
npm ci
npm run generate:docs
npm run dev
package.json
-    "build": "vite build"
+    "build": "npm run generate:docs && vite build"

Code blocks in MDX pages use the same viewer as Markdown pages, with a copy button and syntax colours.
